metadata.title: Equality case in the Kotrbatý-Mouamine inequality
metadata.abstract: Godbersen's long-standing conjecture states that the mixed volumes of any convex body $K \subset \R^n$ satisfy $V(K[k], -K[n-k])\le \binom{n}{k} \vol(K)$ for any $k \in \{1, \dots, n - 1\}$, with equality if and only if $K$ is an $n$-simplex. Kotrbatý and Mouamine recently proved the inequality in full generality, and showed that if $K$ is a (full-dimensional) polytope attaining equality, it must be a simplex. We complete the characterization of the equality case : if $K \subset \R^n$ is a convex body for which $V(K[k], -K[n-k]) = \binom{n}{k} \vol(K)$ for some $k \in \{1, \dots, n -1\}$, then $K$ is an $n$-simplex.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: Godbersen 不等式等号的完整刻画
analysis.workSummary: 在 Kotrbatý–Mouamine 已证明不等式基础上，把多面体的等号刚性推广至任意正体积凸体：任一非平凡 mixed-volume 指标取等即为 simplex。
analysis.breakthrough: 补齐从多面体到一般凸体的等号分类。
analysis.limitations: k 必须在 1 至 n−1；不能把已有不等式部分归为本文首次证明。
